title: 7S.2c LEADER object-handle collision scratch fast slice
scope: Continue the 7S.2c writer-preflight scratch census in dx_iface::planLeaderAnnotationHandles
Replace the all-object handle inventory with a bounded set containing only collisions against LEADER annotation targets
Skip object-handle scans entirely when no annotation targets exist while preserving cross-family collision refusal

method.kind: Local source audit and existing generated ASCII/Binary LEADER selector
method.limitations: Collision behavior is checked by the existing generated selector, including its cross-family layer-handle negative control. This is a targeted scratch reduction, not a complete allocator/RSS bound or LEADER interoperability qualification. Git metadata is read-only in this workspace; the slice remains uncommitted.

details: Removed the second unordered_set containing every non-entity handle. Once annotation target handles are known, each existing object family is scanned for membership in that target set, and only matching handles are retained in objectHandleCollisions.

Skip the cross-family inventory when annotationHandles is empty. All prior object families, named-object dictionary, image, and block handle sources remain covered; zero and sentinel handles remain excluded.
